text:
Ana (Partnerships): Quick sync — compressing timeline for the marketplace partner launch. Need final legal + press kit by EOD Tue, landing page staging by Wed 12:00 PT, and SI deliverables in staging by Wed afternoon. Can partners / owners confirm acceptances and blockers?
Mike (Marketing): We can get a press kit draft Tue AM. Need partner logos in SVG, 2-3 hero images, and partner contact for quote approvals. @Deepa can you do legal check if I send copy by 10:00 PT Tue?
Deepa (Legal): Send copy by 10:00 PT Tue and I'll prioritize. If it lands after 10:00 it likely slips to Thu. Also we need written logo permission (email thread or form).
Leo (SI): SI checklist: docker image + terraform module + OIDC config + sample tenant. We can deliver terraform module Wed 12:00 PT if we get staging account access and partner IP allowlist.
Sara (Product): Landing page needs a short integration diagram (SVG) and a one-liner for data residency. I'll drop copy v1 in #docs today and flag feature flags for dedicated vs hosted variants.
Mike (Marketing): PR timing: planned embargo Fri 09:00 PT. If press kit slips we push the embargo. Need CTO quote — @Tom can you sign off?
Tom (CTO): Happy to provide a quote. Send talking points and a couple suggested lines by Wed and I'll approve by EOD.
press-bot: PR draft created: /drafts/marketplace-partner-announcement.md — review requested from marketing + legal.
Ana (Partnerships): Partner-facing readiness items: confirm partner training session Fri 15:00 PT? @Leo can you run the session? Who owns partner portal invites?
Leo (SI): I can run training but need the SI runbook by Thu latest. Portal invites owned by SI + Ops — I'll take invites after runbook is uploaded.
deploy-bot: Staging env provisioning for partner-sandbox started: job 9845, ETA ~2h.
Deepa (Legal): Quick legal note — do not publish partner customer names or logos without explicit consent. If partner provides logo we need the usage scope (web, press, social).
Mike (Marketing): Noted. Also landing hero image needs hi-res by Wed or we use default hero.
Ana (Partnerships): Consolidated checklist (below) — please call out anything missing.
```
- Press kit: Mike -> draft Tue AM -> Deepa signoff by Tue 10:00 PT
- Landing page staging: Sara copy Tue, Design assets Wed 12:00 PT
- SI deliverables: Leo terraform module Wed 12:00 PT, runbook Thu
- Partner training: Fri 15:00 PT (Leo)
- PR embargo: Fri 09:00 PT (final check Thu EOD)
- Staging provisioning: deploy-bot job in progress
- CTO quote: Tom Wed EOD
- Logo permissions: partner -> Deepa Tue 16:00 PT
```
Tom (CTO): Add me for the quote item — I'll expect talking points by Wed morning.
Deepa (Legal): I'll confirm logo permissions by Tue 16:00 PT and post the permission format here.
Mike (Marketing): I'll ping partners now and ask for assets + permissions. @Ana can you paste the sanitized contact list here?
Ana (Partnerships): Sharing in DM now, will paste sanitized list in this thread in ~30m.
Leo (SI): FYI SI blocker: staging network needs firewall rule for partner IPs — eng-infra ticket #1234 opened.
Sara (Product): Adding fallback hero copy for dedicated customers in case assets are late.
Mike (Marketing): If everything is green I'll slot the PR to production Friday 08:50 PT for embargo workflows.
press-bot: Reminder: PR assets must be uploaded to /press/assets by Thu 18:00 PT to avoid blocking the pipeline.
deploy-bot: Staging env job 9845 completed. Staging endpoints: https://staging.partner-sandbox.redwood.ai. Temporary creds delivered to Leo via vault.
Ana (Partnerships): Great progress — let's reconvene for a short pulse tomorrow 9:00 AM PT in this thread. Please update status inline if anything slips.
